title: Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line Rate Sheet and Interest Calendar
content:
Floorplan interest on the Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line is priced off the prime rate. Each Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade carries its own spread over prime and its own rate floor; the day-count year, the billing day, the due period and the accepted payment channels are set on this sheet as well, together with the early-payoff interest rebate share.

## Rate sheet

| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade | Spread over prime (percent) | Rate floor (percent) | Early-payoff interest rebate share (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6 | 2.75 | 6.5 | 0 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 5 | 2.25 | 6.25 | 0 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 4 | 1.75 | 6.0 | 0 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 3 | 1.25 | 5.75 | 10 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 2 | 0.9 | 5.5 | 15 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1 | 0.6 | 5.25 | 20 |

## Interest calendar and channels

| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade | Days in the interest year | Billing day of the month (for the prior month) | Calendar days after billing until due | Channels accepted for payoffs and interest |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6 | 360 | 5 | 10 | ACH debit, wire |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 5 | 360 | 5 | 10 | ACH debit, wire |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 4 | 360 | 5 | 10 | ACH debit, wire |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 3 | 360 | 5 | 10 | ACH debit, wire |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 2 | 360 | 5 | 10 | ACH debit, wire |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1 | 360 | 5 | 10 | ACH debit, wire |

## Terms as defined for this sheet

- **Spread over prime**: the floorplan rate spread over the prime rate, in percent.
- **Rate floor**: the minimum floorplan rate regardless of prime, in percent.
- **Days in the interest year**: days in the year for floorplan interest.
- **Billing day**: the day of the month on which interest for the prior month is billed.
- **Due period**: calendar days after billing by which interest is due.
- **Early-payoff interest rebate share**: the share of a month's interest rebated when a new unit is sold within the dealer's first 30 days of floor time, in percent.
- **Payment channels**: the channels accepted for floorplan payoffs and interest.

## Reading the sheet

The rebate share is zero on Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6, Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 5 and Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 4, so no early-payoff rebate arises on those grades; it is 10, 15 and 20 percent on Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 3, Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 2 and Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1 respectively.
